title: RetailAnalytics AdSpendStoreSales

stats.done_summary: Completed panel-data retail advertising analysis. Implemented reproducible pipeline in code/run_analysis.py that loads/cleans store-month data, estimates RET-ADV-ROLL policy shares, fits pooled FE, two-way FE, dynamic FE, log-log FE, quadratic FE, and 2SLS IV (policy-implied spend instrument), generates diagnostics/holdout validation, and outputs tables to outputs/ plus figures to report/images/. Wrote publication-style report to report/report.md with methods, results, figures, and budgeting implications.
